title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2609.21650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly relies on human teleoperation demonstrations, while reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse binary rewards faces an exploration challenge when successful trajectories are rarely sampled. We propose SynthDemo-RL, a teacher-student framework in which an automated teacher converts simulator-privileged state into successful manipulation trajectories, a VLA student is distilled from them by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and PPO with binary task-success rewards refines the student. We study reward coverage, the fraction of tasks for which at least one success is observed under the fixed evaluation protocol, as a complement to the average success rate. On LIBERO-PRO, a public benchmark of perturbed LIBERO tasks for which no demonstrations exist, 27 of 57 scored tasks are at exactly 0% success for a pi_0.5 policy fine-tuned on the original LIBERO tasks. translated_title: SynthDemo-RL：利用LLM引导的合成示范突破VLA适配中的零奖励壁垒
translated_abstract: 微调视觉-语言-动作模型通常依赖人工遥操作示范，而采用稀疏二值奖励的强化学习在成功轨迹很少被采样时会面临探索难题。我们提出SynthDemo-RL，这是一个师生框架：自动化的教师将模拟器特权状态转化为成功的操作轨迹，VLA学生模型通过监督微调从这些轨迹中蒸馏学习，随后使用基于二值任务成功奖励的PPO对学生模型进行精调。我们研究了奖励覆盖率，即在固定评估协议下至少观察到一次成功的任务所占比例，作为对平均成功率的补充指标。在LIBERO-PRO（一个由扰动的LIBERO任务构成的公开基准，其中不存在任何示范）上，在原始LIBERO任务上微调的pi_0.5策略在57个评分任务中有27个恰好为0%成功率。直接从该策略进行PPO，在……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SynthDemo-RL师生框架，由自动化教师利用LLM引导将模拟器特权状态转化为合成成功示范，通过SFT蒸馏VLA学生模型并用PPO精调，从而突破VLA适配中零奖励任务的探索壁垒。
en_tdlr: SynthDemo-RL is a teacher-student framework where an automated LLM-guided teacher converts simulator-privileged states into synthetic successful demonstrations, a VLA student is distilled via SFT and refined with PPO, breaking the zero-reward exploration barrier in VLA adaptation.
